answer: Resist sybils by rationing first influence through a scarce work oasis: admission slots equal last epoch's settled surplus, not how many keys an operator can mint. A new name posts a slashable bond plus one reproducible work receipt to take a slot. Voting weight stays at zero until that name reaches a summit of several independently countersigned epochs, each attested by older, unrelated peers. A cheap sparrow monitor samples the vote graph for lockstep cliques among fresh keys; those aliases collapse to one body and the shared bond is slashed, so extra names cost more than they can earn.
